name: clawd-bar
description: Clawd, Claude Code's crab, lives in a band above your prompt: he acts out the session, shows what's running, your context and usage limits, and races your CI builds. Unofficial fan mod.

pet.title: Show Clawd above the prompt
pet.description: Draw this session's Clawd in the band above the prompt

ci.title: Watch CI builds
ci.description: Race Codemagic and GitHub Actions builds above the prompt and alert when they finish

continueAfterBuilds.title: Let Claude continue after builds
continueAfterBuilds.description: When a build finishes in this session's repo, send Claude the result as a new prompt (with the failure log when it fails). Off keeps the race and the alerts.

ntfyTopic.title: ntfy topic
ntfyTopic.description: Private ntfy.sh topic for phone pushes when a build finishes. Leave empty to turn phone pushes off.

bridge.title: Feed Clawd on Desk
bridge.description: Forward session events to the Clawd on Desk app in place of its per-event command hooks. It holds off while those hooks are installed; /clawd desk swaps them over

clawdInstallDir.title: Clawd on Desk app folder
clawdInstallDir.description: Leave empty to find it automatically. Otherwise the installed app's resources/app.asar.unpacked folder
